title: Electronics & Communication Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 (PCM) with JKCET / JEE Main / Management Quota
description: Electronics & Communication Engineering applies science and math to practical communication problems, involving research, design, development, and testing of electronic equipment used in various communication systems.
vision: To emerge as one of the leading Electronics and Communication Engineering programs in the region.
mission: Providing professional competencies in the field of Electronics and Communication engineering.
Promoting holistic development among students and faculty.
peos: The graduate will be able to exhibit professional competency in the field of Electronics and Communication engineering.
The graduate will be able to develop innovative ideas and find creative solutions.
